brand.name: Atithi Devo Bhava
brand.taglineHi: भारत को लोगों के साथ महसूस कीजिए।
brand.secondary: Meet locals. Explore cultures. Experience Indian hospitality.

hero.title: Experience India through its people.
hero.description: Meet local residents, participate in traditional craft sessions, or stay with a verified family. Every profile is reviewed individually. Contact details are shared only when both people agree.

threeWays.title: Three ways to experience India
threeWays.titleHi: भारत का अनुभव करने के तीन मार्ग
threeWays.way1Desc: Connect with an Indian resident for tea, a neighbourhood walk, or language exchange. This is not a paid service by default and requires no commercial hospitality business.
threeWays.way2Desc: Participate in cultural sessions organized by residents, artists, and families. Experiences include cooking, traditional crafts, village walks, and music.
threeWays.way3Desc: Eligible hosts offering home hospitality with verified standards. This feature is in preparation.

howItWorksSection.title: How it works
howItWorksSection.step1Desc: Browse verified local residents, traditional artists, and cultural sessions across Indian districts.
howItWorksSection.step2Desc: Send a connection request with your proposed date and public meeting place. Contact details are revealed only when both sides confirm.
howItWorksSection.step3Desc: Meet safely in a designated public area, learn traditions directly from families, and share honest reviews.

trustSection.title: Trust and community safety
trustSection.desc: Every member is reviewed by a person. Initial meetups are held in public places, and emergency helplines are available around the clock.

becomeHostSection.title: Share your culture with travellers

becomeHostSection.desc: If you live in India and enjoy welcoming respectful international visitors for conversation, walks, or art demonstrations, join our local community.

compliance.title: Host Statutory Compliance Centre
compliance.subtitle: Legal obligations and guest reporting for international visitors.
compliance.formCReminder: Statutory Requirement: Under the Foreigners Act 1946 and Registration of Foreigners Rules, hosts accommodating foreign nationals must report guest arrival within 24 hours via Form C / Form III on the official e-FRRO portal.
compliance.efrroPortalLink: Ministry of Home Affairs e-FRRO Portal
compliance.disclaimer: Statutory Clarification: Atithi Devo Bhava is a technology marketplace and is not an official statutory reporting agency. Compliance reporting remains the direct statutory duty of the host.
compliance.dpdpNotice: DPDP Act Privacy Compliance: Only statutory arrival details and government filing reference numbers are logged. Raw passport scans and visa numbers are never stored.

messaging.subtitle: Coordinate session logistics and meeting details.
messaging.textOnlyNotice: Section 17: Messaging is text-only to protect user privacy. Attachments and external hyperlinks are disabled.
messaging.unrevealedNotice: Contact information has not been mutually confirmed yet. Do not post phone numbers or payment links into the chat.
